settings.name: USE_BACKUP
settings.description: **Enable Backup:** Set to `yes` to enable automatic backups.

settings.name: BACKUP_SCHEDULE
settings.description: **Backup Frequency:** How often to perform backups. Options: `daily`, `weekly`, or `monthly`.

settings.name: BACKUP_ROTATION
settings.description: **Backup Retention:** The number of backup files to keep. Older backups beyond this number will be automatically deleted.

settings.name: BACKUP_DIRECTORY
settings.description: **Backup Location:** The directory where backup files will be stored.
